title: HateXplain confirmatory test of R12 and rescan under the target-prior threshold
status: confirmatory, registered before any model score or prediction was inspected
motivation: M1.39 showed that split halves of the TweetEval/hate official test are not an independent corpus. M1.40 moves the same two candidate arms to a second hate corpus with an official train/val/test division.

dataset.name: HateXplain
dataset.why_not_resplit: The official test is the only held-out split; no TweetEval test labels and no new random split are used.
dataset.majority_rule: require 2-of-3 majority; ties dropped; official splits contain no ties
dataset.secondary_mapping: toxic: hatespeech+offensive=1; normal=0; exploratory only, not part of the primary decision

cleaning.text: join post_tokens with single spaces, collapse whitespace, strip
cleaning.fit_dedup: exact cleaned-text deduplication; texts with conflicting 3-class majority labels dropped
cleaning.test_fit_overlap: test texts present in fit removed
cleaning.tweeteval_overlap: test texts present in TweetEval/hate train or test removed; observed 0

length_audit.tokenizer: all-MiniLM-L12-v2 tokenizer, no truncation, special tokens included

L12.pooling: mean pooling and L2 normalization as emitted by bert6

L6.pooling: mean pooling and L2 normalization as emitted by bert6

probes.logreg: sklearn LogisticRegression, lbfgs, max_iter=5000, random_state=7, class_weight=None
probes.linear_svc: sklearn LinearSVC, max_iter=10000, random_state=7, tol=1e-4, class_weight=None

c_selection.selection_data: f32 embeddings only; f32 and quantized arm share the selected C within a probe and seed
c_selection.metric: accuracy for primary; macro-F1 is reported as a secondary metric with the same C

target_prior.threshold: quantile(scores_test, 1 - prior) per arm, per probe, per seed
target_prior.status: transductive exploratory protocol; not a deployable default

primary_endpoint.comparison: quantized arm minus f32 arm, paired by test example

success_criteria.unit: candidate (L12 R12 or L6 rescan), requiring both probes
success_criteria.confirmed: for both probes, at least 4 of 5 seeds have a paired 95% CI entirely above 0 and the 5-seed mean point delta is > 0
success_criteria.partially_confirmed: one probe meets the 4/5 positive-CI bar and the other has at least 2/5 positive CIs
success_criteria.inconclusive: neither confirmed nor rejected; e.g. both probes are 2-3/5, or one probe is below 2/5 while the other is at least 4/5
success_criteria.rejected: both probes have at most 1/5 positive CIs, or both 5-seed mean point deltas are <= 0 with no positive CI
success_criteria.no_alpha_adjustment: two candidate tests, each requiring both probes; 95% CIs are reported as pre-registered, no post-hoc alpha change

default_0_5.role: reference only; tests whether any gain depends on target_prior

split_half.split: StratifiedKFold(n_splits=2, shuffle=True, random_state=101) on test labels
split_half.threshold: target_prior using only the calibration half scores and fit prior
split_half.evaluation: labels of the other half only
split_half.role_in_decision: none; reported to check calibration/evaluation separation on the new corpus

toxic_mapping.role: exploratory only; not run in the primary matrix and not used in the decision

exclusions: No MNLI or other auxiliary training data
No test labels for C selection or target-prior threshold
No per-arm C tuning for the quantized arm in the primary comparison
No claim that target_prior is a deployable default protocol

interpretation_boundary.independent_corpus: HateXplain is a second corpus, not a split of TweetEval/hate.
interpretation_boundary.seed_independence: five seeds share the same official test labels; seeds vary C and model fitting, not the evaluation examples. Effective independence is reported by C and by probe.
interpretation_boundary.quantized_vs_f32: The comparison is quantized arm minus f32 at the same C; it is not per-arm optimal C.
interpretation_boundary.prior: HateXplain fit and test hate rates are close (0.3090 vs 0.3097), so target_prior is close to the natural prior; this is a favorable condition for the rule and must be stated.
